shorts.title: What you will learn: Strings with std::string
shorts.hook: Strings in C plus plus grow and shrink as you need.
shorts.script: Strings in C plus plus grow and shrink as you need. Today we work with text. The std string type can hold a word, a sentence or a whole page. The std string type holds text of any length. Plus joins two strings. The size function tells you how many letters it holds. Each letter has a position, called an index. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Strings with std::string.

shorts.title: Strings with std::string in one minute
shorts.hook: The std string type holds text of any length.
shorts.script: The std string type holds text of any length. Plus joins two strings. The size function tells you how many letters it holds. Each letter has a position, called an index. The first index is zero, not one. Think of a string of beads. Each bead is one letter, and you count from the first bead as zero. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Strings with std::string in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The string holds a short sentence.
shorts.script: The string holds a short sentence. The find function looks for the word sunny. It returns the index where the word starts. Here that index is seven. The substr function cuts five letters from that index. It prints sunny. The append function adds an exclamation mark at the end. The full line prints. The program prints seven, then sunny, then the whole line with the exclamation mark. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Adding two quoted texts
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in strings with std string?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in strings with std string? Bug of the Day. We try to add two quoted texts. The compiler says invalid operands to binary plus. A quoted text is a plain character array, not a std string. Plus needs at least one real std string. Wrap the first text in string, and it works. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Adding two quoted texts.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you build a greeting from two strings in strings
shorts.script: Can you build a greeting from two strings in strings with std string? Why did the string go to therapy? It could not stop feeling cut off. Store a first name and a village in two strings. Print the sentence, Asha lives in Mapusa, with your own words. Write your answer in the comments. The std string type holds text of any length. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Pun and challenge.
